article.title_es: Celestial Church of Christ Ileri Parish: despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Celestial Church of Christ Ileri Parish: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Esta iglesia en Brooklyn aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos. Abre los sábados de 12pm a 3pm, y la despensa funciona el segundo sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: This Brooklyn church appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry. It is open Saturdays from 12pm to 3pm, and the pantry runs on the 2nd Saturday of the month.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos.
Está ubicada en 138 Waverly Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11205.
La despensa funciona el segundo sábado del mes.
how_they_help_en: Listed on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry.
Located at 138 Waverly Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11205.
The pantry runs on the 2nd Saturday of the month.
You can call (718) 624-8758 to ask questions.
visit_tips_es: Planifique su visita para el segundo sábado del mes, cuando funciona la despensa.
El horario indicado es sábado de 12pm a 3pm.
No se indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; llame antes para preguntar.
visit_tips_en: Plan your visit for the 2nd Saturday of the month, when the pantry runs.
The listed hours are Saturday 12pm to 3pm.
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements; call ahead to ask.
